title: Type definitions (data/defs.json)
description: Object types with their defaults, enemy types, and the look and rules of the special static block types. Spells join in a later phase.

blocks.description: Static block types other than plain blocks (which take the room color). Their behavior and animated look are built into the engine (src/render/block-fx.js); this sets their color and tuning.

hazard.description: Hurts the wizard when he touches it (stands on it or walks into it).

void.description: Kills the wizard instantly when he lands on it.

color.description: Thin frame; also tints the grains inside.

movement.description: Movement behavior (src/ai/behaviors.js). patrol: walks its path (room data "path", required) cell by cell, turning back when blocked; stationary: stays in its cell (still falls and rides platforms).

attack.description: How it hurts the wizard while hostile. contact: touching it; none: never.

hostility.description: hostile: attacks (red eyes); peaceful: never attacks (cyan eyes); provoked: peaceful (amber eyes) until a spell hits it, then hostile.

aggroRange.description: Units within which a hostile enemy notices the wizard (chasing and shooting behaviors, later). No effect on patrol and contact.

integrity.description: Hits it takes to destroy (spells, from step 6).

damage.description: Integrity the wizard loses per attack.

speed.description: Walking speed in units per second (a path's own speed overrides it).

bounce.description: Trampoline top: landing on it bounces the wizard up (clearing 2 blocks) without hurting him; its sides still hurt if it is hostile.

solid.description: Solid: the wizard can not walk through it; he stands on it and rides along, and it shoves him when it walks into him (turning back if he is pinned). Touching it counts when he leans against it. Not solid: he walks through it.

color.description: Body (hologram) color; the eyes show hostility.

kind.description: Which engine behavior the object uses. pushable: the wizard pushes it; platform: follows its path (room data "path") carrying the wizard and pushables; collapsing: shakes when the wizard stands on it, then vanishes (optionally growing back, room data "regrow").

faces.description: dark: like static blocks; tinted: faces shaded in the object color (top lighter).

tint.description: With tinted faces: share of the object color in the top face; the sides get less.
